explanation: They reached the top on 29 May 1953. The news reached London on the morning of Queen Elizabeth II's coronation, 2 June. Hillary had earned his living keeping bees.

claims.text: Edmund Hillary, a New Zealander, and Tenzing Norgay reached the summit of Mount Everest in 1953.
George Mallory died on Everest in 1924, John Hunt led the 1953 expedition without going to the summit, and Reinhold Messner climbed Everest in the 1970s and 1980s; none was a New Zealander.
Hillary and Tenzing reached the summit on 29 May 1953.
News of the ascent reached London on 2 June 1953, the day of Queen Elizabeth II's coronation.
Before his climbing fame, Hillary worked as a beekeeper.
